query: I was ineligible for Matched Retirement Savings Scheme for the past few years after turning 71 years old. With the lifting of the age cap of 70 from 2025, will my eligibility be revised for the past few years?
reference_answer: No, the enhancements start from 2025. With the lifting of the age cap, eligible seniors above 70 can make cash top-ups and receive the same amount of Matched Retirement Savings Scheme (MRSS) matching grant as those aged 55 to 70. The Government has also increased the annual matching grant amount to $2,000, compared to $600 before.
answer: Based on the information available, if the age cap of 70 was lifted to 71 by 2025, your eligibility for the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme might have been revised for the past few years when you were under 71. However, without specific details from the document, an exact revision can't be confirmed. [Document N]
